test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown having numbers 13 to 18. Find the number on the face opposite the face showing '16'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/918b0746f2bb467a60754d3898b6aadcc15b6ea2f8117dad28189d85bbdbee78.png]
solution:
As 17 and 18 are the common faces on both the dice, the remaining faces are opposite to each other.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc4dc0544daa68c8bff57c848aeb0dc2e370af5c037bb01522c4f101a508a75d.png] 

Therefore, '13' is the number on the face opposite the face showing '16'.

Hence, ‘**13**’ is the correct answer.
